query.statement: SELECT WO_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCHEDULED_DATE <= @asOf AND STATUS NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled') ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT WO_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM EMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE
SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM EMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY PART_NAME

SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM EMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CURRENT_STOCK <= MIN_STOCK ORDER BY PART_NAME
SELECT ITEM_CLASS_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM EMS_MAINT_ITEM_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@itemClassId IS NULL OR ITEM_CLASS_ID = @itemClassId) ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS_NAME

SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CLASS_ID, INSPECTION_METHOD, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_MAINT_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@itemClassId IS NULL OR ITEM_CLASS_ID = @itemClassId) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

SELECT EQP_ITEM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID, CYCLE_TYPE, CYCLE_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_EQP_MAINT_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, ITEM_ID
SELECT PART_CLASS_ID, PART_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@partClassId IS NULL OR PART_CLASS_ID = @partClassId) ORDER BY PART_CLASS_NAME

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@transactionType IS NULL OR TRANSACTION_TYPE = @transactionType) AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Incoming' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Move' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT INOUT_ID, PART_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, QUANTITY, FROM_LOCATION, TO_LOCATION, TRANSACTION_AT, PROCESSED_BY FROM EMS_SPARE_PART_INOUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'Scrap' AND (@partId IS NULL OR PART_ID = @partId) ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC
